body:
As described in the Migration App Planning task:
1. Record the decision (next D-number): shell project, apps as Lustre components, and the URLs:
- / → board
- /migrate → migration (/migration is already the JSON API)
- /view and /p/<dir>/view → contract view

Also record the contract each app follows: the app's package exposes register() -> Result(Nil, lustre.Error), a tag name, attributes it reads (e.g. base, the /p/<dir> prefix), and its own CSS.
title: Record the decision
